companies.name: Transocean
companies.note: Acquiring Valaris for $5.8B (announced Feb 2026); closing expected Q4 2026 per Valaris Q2 release (Aug 5, 2026). Q2 2026 reported Aug 5.

company_profile.business_model: Ultra-deepwater와 harsh-environment floater 중심의 offshore drilling contractor. 고사양 drillship과 semisubmersible을 장기 계약으로 운용한다.
company_profile.strategy: Valaris 인수로 글로벌 floater 규모를 확대하고, 고사양 7세대 drillship과 harsh-environment 리그의 dayrate 회복을 수익성 개선의 핵심 축으로 둔다.
company_profile.notable: 업계 최대 수준의 ultra-deepwater backlog를 보유한 순수 floater 강자. Valaris 인수 완료 시 jackup exposure까지 포함한 대형 통합 offshore driller가 된다.
company_profile.rig_mix_source: Transocean FSR Aug 5 2026: UDW 드릴십 20(계류 3 포함) + HE 반잠수식 7
company_profile.business_model_en: Offshore drilling contractor focused on ultra-deepwater and harsh-environment floaters. Operates high-spec drillships and semisubmersibles on long-term contracts.
company_profile.strategy_en: Expanding global floater scale through the Valaris acquisition; dayrate recovery for high-spec 7th-generation drillships and harsh-environment rigs is the core lever for improving profitability.
company_profile.notable_en: Pure-play floater leader with one of the industry's largest ultra-deepwater backlogs. On completing the Valaris acquisition it becomes a large integrated offshore driller including jack-up exposure.
company_profile.rig_mix_source_en: Transocean FSR Aug 5 2026: 20 UDW drillships (incl. 3 stacked) + 7 HE semisubmersibles

companies.name: Valaris
companies.note: Merger with Transocean pending ($5.8B, announced Feb 2026); on track to close in Q4 2026 (Q2 release, Aug 5, 2026). Earnings calls discontinued.

company_profile.business_model: Drillship, semisubmersible, jackup을 모두 보유한 diversified offshore drilling contractor. Deepwater와 jackup 계약을 함께 운용한다.
company_profile.strategy: Transocean과의 합병 전까지 backlog 방어와 fleet utilization 개선에 집중한다. 합병 완료 후에는 Transocean의 floater 중심 포트폴리오와 통합될 예정이다.
company_profile.notable: Transocean과의 합병 발표 이후 독립 실적 가이던스와 earnings call을 중단한 상태다. 현재 데이터는 합병 전 stand-alone Valaris 기준이다.
company_profile.rig_mix_source: Valaris FSR Aug 5 2026: 드릴십 13(계류 3), 잭업 28(ARO 임대 7 포함; 104·109 2026-06/07 매각, 111 2026-09 재활용 매각 제외). 반잠수식 MS-1은 2026-09 재활용 매각으로 제외
company_profile.business_model_en: Diversified offshore drilling contractor owning drillships, semisubmersibles and jack-ups. Operates both deepwater and jack-up contracts.
company_profile.strategy_en: Until the merger with Transocean, focused on defending backlog and improving fleet utilization. After closing, it will be integrated into Transocean's floater-centric portfolio.
company_profile.notable_en: Has suspended stand-alone guidance and earnings calls since the Transocean merger announcement. Current data reflect stand-alone, pre-merger Valaris.
company_profile.rig_mix_source_en: Valaris FSR Aug 5 2026: 13 drillships (3 stacked), 28 jack-ups (incl. 7 leased to ARO; excl. 104/109 sold Jun/Jul 2026 and 111 recycled Sep 2026). Semisub MS-1 excluded (recycled Sep 2026)

companies.name: Noble
companies.note: Acquired Diamond Offshore in 2024. Sold jackups to Borr Drilling (Jan 2026). Now pureplay deepwater.

company_profile.business_model: Deepwater drillship와 semisubmersible 중심의 offshore drilling contractor. Diamond Offshore 인수 후 deepwater pure-play로 재편했다.
company_profile.strategy: 잭업 매각 이후 고사양 floater 중심으로 포트폴리오를 단순화하고, Petrobras, Shell, Chevron 등 deepwater 고객의 장기 계약을 확대한다.
company_profile.notable: Diamond Offshore 인수와 jackup 매각 이후 deepwater pure-play 성격이 강해졌다. Q1 2026 실적이 이미 반영된 유일한 시추선사다.
company_profile.rig_mix_source: Noble FSR Jul 27 2026: marketed 29척 — 드릴십 17(7G 14 + 6G 3), 반잠수식 7, UH 잭업 5
company_profile.business_model_en: Offshore drilling contractor focused on deepwater drillships and semisubmersibles. Repositioned as a deepwater pure-play after acquiring Diamond Offshore.
company_profile.strategy_en: After selling its jack-ups, it simplifies the portfolio around high-spec floaters and expands long-term contracts with deepwater clients such as Petrobras, Shell and Chevron.
company_profile.notable_en: Has become more of a deepwater pure-play after the Diamond Offshore acquisition and jack-up sale. Was the only driller whose Q1 2026 results were already reflected.
company_profile.rig_mix_source_en: Noble FSR Jul 27 2026: 29 marketed rigs — 17 drillships (14 7G + 3 6G), 7 semisubmersibles, 5 UH jack-ups

companies.name: Seadrill
companies.note: FY2025 Adj. EBITDA $353M. 2026 guidance raised twice — latest (Aug 2026): Rev $1.50–1.55B, EBITDA $420–450M.

company_profile.business_model: High-spec ultra-deepwater drillship와 semisubmersible 중심의 offshore drilling contractor. 재무구조 재편 이후 고사양 floater에 집중한다.
company_profile.strategy: 브라질, US Gulf of Mexico, 서아프리카 deepwater 수요에 맞춰 drillship 가동률과 dayrate를 회복시키는 데 집중한다.
company_profile.notable: 상대적으로 작은 floater 포트폴리오지만 브라질과 US Gulf deepwater exposure가 크다. 2026년 가이던스는 EBITDA 회복을 전제로 한다.
company_profile.rig_mix_source: Seadrill FSR Aug 10 2026: 자사 소유 드릴십 10(West Gemini 포함)·반잠수식 5(계류 3) — 이 외 Sonangol 소유 관리 드릴십 2
company_profile.business_model_en: Offshore drilling contractor focused on high-spec ultra-deepwater drillships and semisubmersibles. Concentrates on high-spec floaters after its financial restructuring.
company_profile.strategy_en: Focused on restoring drillship utilization and dayrates in line with deepwater demand in Brazil, the US Gulf of Mexico and West Africa.
company_profile.notable_en: A relatively small floater portfolio but large exposure to Brazil and US Gulf deepwater. 2026 guidance assumes an EBITDA recovery.
company_profile.rig_mix_source_en: Seadrill FSR Aug 10 2026: 10 owned drillships (incl. West Gemini), 5 semisubmersibles (3 stacked) — plus 2 Sonangol-owned managed drillships

companies.name: Borr Drilling
companies.note: Pure-play jackup. 29 modern jackups (all post-2008). Acquired 5 Noble jackups Jan 2026. 5 more premium jackups via 50/50 JV ($287M, Jul 2026). Debt fully refinanced Q2 2026.

company_profile.business_model: Modern premium jackup pure-play. 중동, 동남아, 멕시코 등 shallow-water drilling 수요에 집중한다.
company_profile.strategy: Noble에서 인수한 잭업 5기를 포함해 premium jackup 규모를 확대하고, 높은 utilization과 낮은 unit cost를 통해 EBITDA 마진을 방어한다.
company_profile.notable: 대형 floater 업체들과 달리 premium jackup에 특화되어 dayrate 수준은 낮지만, utilisation과 EBITDA margin이 높은 편이다.
company_profile.business_model_en: Modern premium jack-up pure-play. Focused on shallow-water drilling demand in the Middle East, Southeast Asia, Mexico and elsewhere.
company_profile.strategy_en: Expanding premium jack-up scale, including the 5 jack-ups acquired from Noble, and defending EBITDA margins through high utilization and low unit costs.
company_profile.notable_en: Unlike the large floater companies it specializes in premium jack-ups, so dayrates are lower but utilization and EBITDA margin tend to be high.
